Now, he's turning to darker stories once again as he dives into Nocturne , an adaptation of Lars Kepler's best-selling novel, The Sandman .
Graham plays notorious and sadistic serial killer Jurek Walter in the show, while it's up to Jonah Lynn (Liev Schreiber) to hunt him down and put a stop to his killing spree. With one victim left to find, Lynn goes to desperate lengths to try and bring peace to his sleepy town in Western Pennsylvania. Along the way he enlists the help of his surrogate daughter, FBI Agent Saga Bauer (Zazie Beetz), to solve the horrific mystery.
